import unittest
import pytest
from conftest import trace


class LifecycleCase(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setup_class(cls):
        trace("setup_class")

    @classmethod
    def teardown_class(cls):
        trace("teardown_class")

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        trace("setUpClass")
        cls.addClassCleanup(trace, "class-cleanup-first")
        cls.addClassCleanup(trace, "class-cleanup-last")

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        trace("tearDownClass")

    def setup_method(self, method):
        trace("setup_method", method=method.__name__)

    def teardown_method(self, method):
        trace("teardown_method", method=method.__name__)

    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
    def resource(self, request):
        trace("fixture-setup", same_instance=request.instance is self)
        yield
        trace("fixture-teardown", same_instance=request.instance is self)

    def setUp(self):
        assert not hasattr(self, "touched")
        self.touched = True
        trace("setUp", method=self._testMethodName)
        self.addCleanup(trace, "cleanup-first", method=self._testMethodName)
        self.addCleanup(trace, "cleanup-last", method=self._testMethodName)

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("tearDown", method=self._testMethodName)

    def test_b(self):
        trace("test", method=self._testMethodName)

    def test_a(self):
        trace("test", method=self._testMethodName)
